description: The map displays a satellite image of a coastal region near Vigo, Spain, highlighting marine inlets and fjords. Two large, dark blue/black water bodies are explicitly labelled "8330", referring to "Marine inlets and fjords" as defined in the Natura 2000 Habitats Directive (92/43/EEC). Yellow lines delineate the entry points of these inlets from the sea. The image uses a false-colour composite where water bodies appear deep blue or black, dense vegetation or forested areas are represented in dark red, and lighter green or cyan areas indicate agricultural land or urban/sparsely vegetated zones. Small white patches are also visible, likely representing built-up areas or bare ground. A yellow arrow in the top right corner indicates the North direction. Another yellow arrow points along an inland river feature, flowing into one of the marine inlets. A zoomed-in inset, outlined in yellow, provides a detailed view of a specific coastal inlet, showing the interface between the water, coastal settlement, and surrounding vegetation. The overall spatial pattern illustrates deeply incised, elongated marine inlets extending inland, characteristic of a ria coast, surrounded by varied land cover.
